note: Implemented Bidirectional Linear Subspace Appearance Tracking with SVD Eigen-templates, Huber ICLK solver via IRLS, and Continuous White Noise Acceleration RTS zero-phase smoother in vaila/tracking, integrated into getpixelvideo.py.

governing_check_baseline.pytest: 8 passed in tests/test_subspace_tracker.py, 48 passed across getpixelvideo suites

targets.evidence: calibrate() decomposes 30 anchor patches via thin SVD into mean template t_bar and eigenbasis U_d meeting 95% energy threshold.
align_patch() solves A z = r0 with dynamic Huber thresholding (delta = 1.345 * MAD), achieving sub-pixel convergence (<0.005 px) and rejecting outlier noise.
RTSSmoother executes forward Kalman filtering under CWNA 6D model and backward RTS smoothing, validated to have peak cross-correlation at lag = 0 (Delta phi = 0).
Added Track RTS button and hotkey T in getpixelvideo.py with anchor validation, live notification banner, coordinates population, and *_subspace_track_m{idx}.csv export.
8 unit/benchmark tests in test_subspace_tracker.py verify sub-pixel accuracy, zero phase, occlusion robustness, and end-to-end trajectory recovery.

lessons: OpenCV getRectSubPix requires float32 or uint8 input arrays; float64 arrays cause (-210:Unsupported format) error.
In Inverse Compositional Lucas-Kanade, the warp update on the image is p <- p - dp (subtracting dp, not adding dp).
cv2.Sobel with ksize=3 sums to 8 across the kernel, requiring scale=1.0/8.0 to yield exact physical derivatives in intensity per pixel.
Continuous white noise acceleration (CWNA) with backward RTS smoothing guarantees zero phase delay (Delta phi = 0), avoiding peak timing shifts in biomechanical velocities.
